tasks.title: Countdown
tasks.starter:
count = 5
while count > 0:
    print(count)
    count = count - 1
print("Lift off!")

hints.lines: Go! should print once, after the loop, so don't indent it. And stop before 0.
hints.other: Start value, condition, update: count > 0, and take one off each time.

n = 1

hints.error: Replace ____ with a question about n, like n <= 12.
